calls.statement:
WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, cp.subcategory
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-07-27'
    AND (cp.category = 'Garden' OR cp.subcategory = 'Outdoor Lighting')
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS n_distinct, SUM(net_amount) AS net, MIN(net_amount) AS minnet,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line) AS dup_return_ids,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_return_line WHERE refund_net < 0) AS neg_refunds,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM fact_return_line) AS multi_returns_per_line,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_return_line r LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f USING (sales_line_id) WHERE f.sales_line_id IS NULL) AS orphan_returns
FROM sold

calls.statement:
WITH sold_lines AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, cp.subcategory, f.net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 1
    AND cp.category = 'Garden' AND cp.subcategory <> 'Outdoor Lighting'
),
refunds AS (
  SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS fiscal_quarter, l.subcategory,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct,
       SUM(l.net_amount) AS sold_net, COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net),0) AS returned_net,
       MAX(l.sale_date) + 30 <= (SELECT MAX(calendar_date) FROM dim_date) AS cohort_complete
FROM sold_lines l LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY l.subcategory ORDER BY return_rate_pct DESC
